title: Mail
intro: Let your agents read a mailbox over IMAP, and write mail over SMTP if you allow it. It works with any provider that offers IMAP and SMTP.
limits: This connection does not answer incoming mail by itself. An agent works on your mail only when you ask it in a chat. Everything in the mailbox is reachable, so connect only a mailbox you want the agent to read.
name: Name
checkSeveral: The login checks run when you have one mail connection, because a check from this page cannot tell which one you mean. In a chat, enable the connections in the Tools menu.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The agent can no longer reach this mailbox, and the password saved with it is deleted. To set it up again you must enter everything again.

replace: Change the server or login details
savedAs: Saved for {{address}}. The servers and the password are kept sealed and cannot be shown. To change any of them, enter all of them again.
addressHelp: The address of the mailbox. It is also the From address of mail the agent sends.
addressShape: Write one plain address, for example name@example.com.
displayHelp: Shown next to the address on mail the agent sends.
displayShape: Use up to 100 characters on one line.
usernameHelp: The login of both servers. Often the full address.
userShape: Enter the username of the mailbox.
passwordHelp: Many providers need an app password here, not the normal one. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
passShape: The password is up to 512 characters, with no line break.
imapHostShape: Write the IMAP server name only, like imap.example.com: no https://, port or path.
smtpHostShape: Write the SMTP server name only, like smtp.example.com: no https://, port or path.
imapPortSecurityMismatch: Port 993 uses TLS; port 143 uses STARTTLS. Make the port and the protection match.
smtpPortSecurityMismatch: Port 465 uses TLS; port 587 uses STARTTLS. Make the port and the protection match.
plainNotConfirmed: Confirm that you accept sending the password without protection, or choose TLS or STARTTLS.

security.label: Protection
security.plainWarning: Without protection the password and all mail travel as plain text. Anyone on the network path can read them. Use it only on a network you trust.
security.plainConfirm: I accept that the password and mail are sent without protection.

foldersHelp: One per line. Leave empty to allow every folder. A folder that is not listed is refused, and the INBOX is matched without regard to case.
foldersShape: A folder name is up to 200 characters on one line.
draftsHelp: Only needed when the server does not mark its drafts folder. Drafts go to the folder the server marks as Drafts first.
tooLong: The connection is too long to save. Shorten the folder list.

setup.title: How to connect a mailbox
setup.step1: Find the IMAP and SMTP server names of your provider in its help pages. Both use TLS or STARTTLS.
setup.step2: If the provider supports it, create an app password for LocalAI and use it as the password. A normal password often does not work with IMAP.
setup.step3: Enter the address, the username, the password and the two servers, then save. Saving logs in to both servers.
setup.step4: Choose whether the agent may also send and draft mail. Each send and each draft waits for your confirmation, in either mode.
setup.private: The mail servers must be on the public internet: addresses inside a private network are refused.

writeMode.label: What the agent may do with mail
writeMode.hint: Sending and saving drafts. It never deletes, moves, flags or forwards mail.

line.propose: Each send and each draft waits for your OK.

note.off: Write access is off: this connection only reads.
note.propose: Each send and each draft waits in your approvals until you confirm it. A sent mail cannot be taken back, and everyone in To and Cc will read it.

approval.subject: Subject
approval.cut: The text shown here is cut. The full text, {{bytes}} bytes, is used.
approval.noteSend: Sending cannot be taken back. Everyone in To and Cc will read this from your address.
approval.noteDraft: This is saved in your Drafts folder. Nothing is sent.
